Independent Fraction rational column reduction reproduced augmented boundary ranks (1,19,131,389,421), hence reduced rational Betti (0,0,0,5,23). Independently reconstructed seven class homology traces using signed oriented simplicial action and exact boundary-image bases: H3=(5,-3,1,2,0,-1,0), H4=(23,1,-1,-1,1,1,3) in RESULT class order 1^5,2 1^3,3 1^2,2^2 1,4 1,3 2,5. The first is sign tensor five-letter permutation, the second 24 directed Hamiltonian 5-cycle permutation minus its unique sign line. Group invariants (H3=0,H4=1), transfer after barycentric subdivision, and dimensional multiplication imply quotient rational cohomology ring Q in degrees 0 and 4 only. No integral equivariant lattice asserted.
